plan_name: Flower Delivery App MVP Execution Plan

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with users, flowers, orders, order_items, cart, and deliveries tables
Build Node.js/Express backend API with authentication endpoints (register, login, logout)
Implement flower catalog API endpoints (GET flowers by category, GET flower details, search)
Create React components for Home Screen with category browsing and popular flowers grid
Build Flower Detail Screen with image carousel, quantity selector, and add-to-cart functionality
Implement shopping cart API endpoints (add item, update quantity, remove item, get cart)
Create Shopping Cart Screen with cart items list, promo code input, and order summary
Integrate Stripe API for payment processing in checkout flow
Build Checkout Screen with delivery address form, payment method selection, and order placement
Implement order creation API endpoint with inventory stock validation and payment processing
Create Order Tracking Screen with status timeline and delivery progress display
Integrate SendGrid for order confirmation and status update email notifications
Build admin inventory management API endpoints (add flower, update stock, deactivate product)
Create User Profile Screen with order history, saved addresses, and account settings
Implement responsive design breakpoints for tablet and desktop views
Add accessibility features including WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support
Set up database indexes on frequently queried columns (email, category, order_number, status)
Implement order status update API with delivery driver assignment and tracking

risks: Stripe API integration complexity may delay payment processing implementation
Stock inventory synchronization issues could lead to overselling during high traffic
SendGrid email delivery delays or failures may impact customer order notifications
Mobile responsiveness testing across multiple devices may reveal layout inconsistencies
Database performance degradation with large product catalogs without proper indexing
